name: loadState covers started+finished and failed(errorCode)
note: dead-port loadRequest failures on macOS 26 WebKit commit about:blank (started/finished) instead of calling didFail; the cancel path above is the deterministic failed-frame source

name: D26 popup windows — window.open path
detail: session A page window.open('/a-popup-open.html') loaded a popup webview (SSE + http hit + on-screen NSWindow owned by 83SmokeA); session B same (b-popup). Popups are plain titled NSWindows (no toolbar) built from the opener's WKWebViewConfiguration via wry new_window_req_handler → NewWindowResponse::Create.

name: D26 popup windows — target=_blank path
detail: page's synthetic HTMLAnchorElement.click() on <a target=_blank> (a-target.html) opened a second popup in the SAME session (SSE + http hit); both A popups stayed open concurrently. Same WKUIDelegate path as window.open per D26.

name: D26 popup cleanup — session close closes all owned popups
detail: child process exit closed session A's connection: a-main, a-popup-open, a-target SSE streams all disconnected within the same instant; on-screen window count for 83SmokeA dropped to 0. Distinct-session isolation: session B's popup (b-popup) and content stayed connected and its window remained.

name: D26 popup cleanup — explicit window destroy
detail: win.destroy() of session B closed b-popup + b-second together; final on-screen opentray-window count 0.

name: D24 loadState — started/finished with url
detail: facade onLoadState received started+finished for b-main.html and b-second.html; finished frames carry progress=1 (macOS reports progress); frames carry owner windowId/webviewId/seq (per-view monotonic).

name: D24 loadState — failed with errorCode
detail: navigate to a hanging URL then navigate again: WebKit cancelled the hanging provisional navigation (didFailProvisionalNavigation, NSURLErrorCancelled) → loadState failed frame with errorCode=-999 delivered end-to-end through the LoadStateNavigationDelegate wrapper → ViewEvents → outbox → ext-event mirror → facade.

name: substrate finding — dead-port loadRequest failures
detail: on this macOS 26 WebKit, loadRequest to a connection-refused port does NOT call didFail*: WebKit commits about:blank (surfacing honestly as loadState started/finished about:blank). Cancellations (the /hang probe) DO deliver didFail(-999). Toolbar (8.5) should treat any terminal phase as progress-bar-close; Windows 8.4 must verify its own NavigationFailed coverage.

name: input-blocked verification gaps (host)
detail: middle-click and right-click context menu ('Open Link in New Window') cannot be synthesized on this host (osascript assistive access blocked -25211, no cliclick/pyobjc — same machine constraints recorded in smoke2-focus). Both routes funnel into the identical WKUIDelegate createWebViewWithConfiguration callback verified via window.open/target=_blank; wry's UI delegate presence is what enables the default WebKit context-menu entry.

name: host visibility note
detail: this host cannot grant app activation (frontmost pinned elsewhere), so app-mode main windows auto-hide on blur; on-screen counts therefore under-report — SSE liveness (document unload) is the authoritative popup-death signal and window counts corroborate.

name: pre-existing defect found & fixed
detail: legacy show() primary (wry .build replaces the window contentView) + later create-webview children (build_as_child on the stale cached content view) aborted the broker at wry wkwebview/mod.rs:392 ns_view.window().unwrap(). Reproduced on the PRE-CHANGE dylib (baseline), root-caused, fixed in build_child_webview by resolving the host view from the live window.contentView(). This was the smoke's first crash; not introduced by 8.3.

name: operational lesson
detail: staging a new extension dylib while a same-endpoint broker stays alive serves the OLD dylib ('already-running' reuse keys on broker identity, not the extension). Fresh HOME per smoke run is mandatory; two earlier misleading runs (no failed frame, no delegate callbacks) were stale-broker artifacts.
